properties.description: Resolves the designs to compose (pins read from their committed exports through tracked.rs's read_document when served alone; live stores through other_design_named on a registry), calls DesignGraph::compose_many, and shapes the reply: by_design, by_pair, across, of_the_whole, counts, not_composed, bounded by budget_chars sampling only the finding lists.
properties.name: service/composed.rs — compose_and_analyse over several designs at once (other_graph_ids, tracked_designs), attributed per design and per pair
